rules.old:
LogPrintf("ERROR: %s: Missing input %d in transaction \'%s\'\n",
                      __func__, i, tx.GetHash().GetHex())
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "transaction_input_missing", "ERROR: {source_function}: Missing input {input_index} in transaction '{tx_hash}'").Field(BCLog::LogField::SourceFunction, __func__).Field(BCLog::LogField::InputIndex, i).Field(BCLog::LogField::TxHash, tx.GetHash())
rules.review_note: Keep original Info level, exact error/BUG wording, indices, guards, return/state decisions. Input index is actual size_t UINT. Missing-input transaction serialization GetHash is TxHash (not V2 GetId); mempool identifier remains actual TxId. Hashes copied raw and hex rendered on consumer. No new payloads or consensus behavior.

rules.old:
LogPrintf("%s: BUG! PLEASE REPORT THIS! Attempt to add txid %s, but "
                  "its outputs are already spent in the "
                  "mempool\n",
                  __func__, txid.ToString())
rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "mempool_child_before_parent", "{source_function}: BUG! PLEASE REPORT THIS! Attempt to add txid {txid}, but its outputs are already spent in the mempool").Field(BCLog::LogField::SourceFunction, __func__).Field(BCLog::LogField::TxId, txid)

reviewed_input.format: %s: BUG! PLEASE REPORT THIS! Attempt to add txid %s, but its outputs are already spent in the mempool

rules.review_note: Keep original Info level, exact error/BUG wording, indices, guards, return/state decisions. Input index is actual size_t UINT. No new payloads or consensus behavior.
